statusMessage.title: statusMessage
statusMessage.description:
Once the RFM analysis flow completes, display the following message to the user:
RFM analysis for the specified(replace with actual specified period) sales period is now complete.
Then prompt the user with:
"Would you like to confirm the results by retrieving a few sample records from predefined categories such as
1) Champions 
2) Lost Loyalists
3) Steady Spenders and more
